creator: nocturne
statement: Acorn Assault is the level 30 Worship totem located in World 1 map The Roots.

creator: nocturne
statement: The totem gives Rooted Souls when you spend Worship Charge or complete Tower Defense waves.

creator: nocturne
statement: Spec into Stop Right There for tower defense; it immobilizes monsters in a radius, and higher level roots longer.

creator: nocturne
statement: Spec into 360 No Scope, which lets you hit multiple mobs.

creator: nocturne
statement: Spec into Kung Fu Kick on Tab 2 to push mobs back; higher level pushes farther.

creator: nocturne
statement: Also take Piercing Arrow since it can hit multiple enemies.

creator: nocturne
statement: Damage is capped at 1 per attack in tower defense, so you don't need to spec every damage-giving talent.

creator: nocturne
statement: He has reached wave 53 with this build but thinks he can push further; it is only one of several possible tower placements.

creator: nocturne
statement: To start waves click the totem then click summon to begin summoning towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Start with a Boulder Roller beside the rope, a second Boulder Roller, then a Freeze Tower, then summon Lightning Totems beneath it.

creator: nocturne
statement: After the basic setup, focus on leveling towers and placing Party Towers, leveling each individually as you add more.

creator: nocturne
statement: Place only one Party Tower at a time and get it to level 5 quickly before placing the next, since they do nothing until level 5.

creator: nocturne
statement: At Party Tower level 5 select the 25% speed option so Boulder Towers and others attack faster, clearing waves and summoning towers quicker.

creator: nocturne
statement: Later in the game add 2 more Party Towers at the bottom, which needs a higher wave count.

creator: nocturne
statement: Upgrade Boulder Roller Towers first, to level 5.

creator: nocturne
statement: Generally select the upgrade 'can hit +2 more enemies' on Boulder Rollers.

creator: nocturne
statement: On the secondary Boulder tower you can pick 'travel 30% further' first.

creator: nocturne
statement: The travel-further option depends on having enough Party Attack Speed to support hitting enough enemies.

creator: nocturne
statement: Always select Trait B on the Frozone Malone Towers, then start upgrading Stormcaller Towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: On two Stormcallers take extra Crit Chance and on the other two take 50% damage to monsters below 60% HP, then eventually have Crit on all 4.

creator: nocturne
statement: Skip upgrading the Kraken Tower early since it's expensive and generally not worth it.

creator: nocturne
statement: After level 5 on towers, push on to upgrading Boulder Towers again.

creator: nocturne
statement: He got stuck from lack of damage because he hasn't upgraded far enough in Construction Workbench; Boulder Rollers around level 30.

creator: nocturne
statement: He got stuck from lack of damage because he hasn't upgraded far enough in Construction Workbench; Boulder Rollers around level 30.

creator: nocturne
statement: Later waves are overwhelming; keep upgrading towers in Tower Defense, particularly Boulder Rollers and Stormcallers, or you'll die sooner.

creator: nocturne
statement: Upgrade Party Towers in increments of 5 levels.

creator: nocturne
statement: Party Towers do nothing without the Attack Speed buff they get every 5 levels.

creator: nocturne
statement: Use Roots and Knockbacks effectively to keep exploding orange mobs off your towers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Orange exploding mobs stun towers, slowing attack speed or preventing damage entirely.
